### Which file do I download?

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows 10 or 11** | `TaskPill-Setup-…-Windows.exe` (the installer, recommended) |
| Windows, without installing | `TaskPill-…-Windows-Portable.zip` (unzip anywhere, run `TaskPill.exe`) |
| **Mac with Apple Silicon** (M1 or newer, macOS 12+) | `TaskPill-…-Mac-AppleSilicon.dmg` (drag TaskPill into Applications) |

Intel Macs aren't supported yet. First time on a Mac: macOS blocks the app once; open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. Install steps are in the [README](https://github.com/manasvimittal-22/taskpill#readme). "Source code" below is for developers.
